title: Changelog & Updates
message:
1. Added dedicated **[Support Guide](/guide)** covering team protocols, work.ink fixes, bin replacements, and crash playbooks.
2. Added full rendering support for **videos, images, and downloadable script cards** (.bat, .exe, .zip) in the QRs view.
3. Added a secret **hidden Easter Egg** somewhere on the site, can you find it?
4. Major **API optimizations**, the bot responses and queries are now significantly faster.
footerNote: This is a continuous project. Feel free to contact me for new features or bug reports.
